item.title: North Bay Battalion get timely goals and great goaltending to beat Sudbury
item.description: Jack Lisson providing more magic between the pipes as he stopped 40 shots in North Bay's crucial 6-3 win in Sudbury on Friday night

item.title: Some unionized school bus drivers have asked to go back to work
item.description: Alouette Bus Lines says it has been approached by striking drivers who want to go back to work after company began using replacement drivers

item.title: West Ferris residents asked to weigh-in on future of arena
item.description: West Ferris residents are asking to weigh-in on the future of the West Ferris Arena. The City of North Bay says they’re shaping future plans for the arena and the Steve Omischl Sports Complex. Consultations with facility user groups, local schools, and neighbouring residents are already underway and will be followed in the coming weeks […]

item.title: Powassan Voodoos chop down the Lumberjacks winning 6-3 Saturday night in Hearst
item.description: Saturday's win still gives the Voodoos an outside shot at second place in the NOJHL although they would have to get a little help to move up that high

item.title: It's two out of three for the Powassan Voodoos on always tough northern swing
item.description: The Voodoos fired 55 shots on the Storm net on the way to a 6-0 win in Iroquois Falls

item.title: Another golden day for Parry Sound's Olympic champion Megan Oldham
item.description: Golden sunshine, and well over 1,000 fans, greeted gold medal winning Winter Olympic star Megan Oldham for a day of celebration in her home town of Parry Sound

item.title: North Bay Battalion stay red-hot crushing the Niagara IceDogs 5-0
item.description: Capping off a perfect weekend, the Battalion smothered the visiting IceDogs and Jack Lisson earned the shout out in the club's 5-0 win
